verdict.rationale: GPU acceleration backends are a fair axis for a local LLM runner, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions a Vulkan backend or AMD GPU acceleration without ROCm. The generic `--gpu` offload flag on `lms load` does not establish Vulkan or AMD support, and one community comment wishes LM Studio worked better on Radeon hardware.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install
